beliefs: Only the first character of a string is transformed; the rest is copied unchanged (abc→cbc, bcd→dcd, Hello→Jello) [E3, E4, E5]
Lowercase letters are shifted forward by 2 with wrap-around (a→c, z→b) [E2, E3, E6]
Uppercase letters are shifted forward by 2 with wrap-around (A→C, Z→B) [E1, E3, E6, E7]
Digits, punctuation, and spaces are left unchanged [E1, E4, E5, E7]
The empty string maps to itself, and a leading space is left unchanged (only letters shift) [E7]
notes: E7 showed a leading space is NOT shifted (space stays space), so non-letter first chars are unchanged — my v5 already did this; the only mismatch was the empty-string/space edge, which the code already handles correctly. Beliefs clarified to state non-letters at position 0 are unchanged.
